guidance: Keep the contract deterministic and skim-friendly. Use code blocks for example payloads/schemas. Prefer explicit status codes and trigger conditions. Do not invent auth or pagination details unless stated or clearly required. Avoid full platform-wide API catalogs.

outline.title: Context
outline.guidance: Frame why this API change is needed.

children.title: Objective
children.guidance: Product or technical need that requires this API change.

outline.title: Endpoints
outline.guidance: Group endpoint contracts. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Endpoint
children.guidance: Title each instance with METHOD and path, e.g. "POST /v1/users".

children.title: Route & Method
children.guidance: HTTP method and path, plus a one-line purpose.

children.title: Request Payload
children.guidance: Expected input schema or example. Prefer a code block.

children.title: Response Payload
children.guidance: Success output schema or example. Prefer a code block.

outline.title: Error Handling
outline.guidance: Group error states for this API change.

children.title: Error State
children.guidance: Title each instance with status code and short label, e.g. "404 Not Found".

children.title: Trigger
children.guidance: Specific condition that causes this error.

children.title: Error Body
children.guidance: Example error payload if the API returns a structured body. Prefer a code block.
